description: REEF3D::CORAL drives three FNPF point absorbers 1 m apart (X 20 3, Z 40 1, three fluid_body, each on a heave joint with a PTO damper) on a refined mesh (G 1 1, a zone around each body): released 3, 2 and 1 cm above equilibrium; the loads and the added mass with the cross terms of all bodies to CORAL, CORAL's poses back to each body; REEF3D_FNPF_6DOF and REEF3D_CORAL compared.
covers: fnpf_6DOF external dynamics with several bodies and mesh refinement (ext_loads with the cross added mass)
